```{r}
# helper rescale to 0-1
rescale01 <- function(x, min_val, max_val) {
  (x - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
}
```

```{r review-helpers}

STUDY_NUM <- "1"
STUDY_TAG <- "s1"

# p-value and significance formatting used by all new exports (LaTeX-safe).
fmt_p3 <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "",
                      ifelse(p < 0.001, "$<$0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
p_txt  <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< .001", sprintf("= %.3f", p))   # for prose
stars3 <- function(p) dplyr::case_when(is.na(p) ~ "", p < .001 ~ "***", p < .01 ~ "**",
                                       p < .05 ~ "*", p < .10 ~ "†", TRUE ~ "")
stars_tex <- function(s) gsub("†", "$\\dagger$", s, fixed = TRUE)

# Study 2 has group_display_labels but not relabel_groups_in_string; define it
# if missing so every export uses the same \textsc{} labels.
if (!exists("relabel_groups_in_string")) {
  relabel_groups_in_string <- function(x) {
    keys <- names(group_display_labels)[order(-nchar(names(group_display_labels)))]
    for (k in keys) x <- gsub(k, group_display_labels[[k]], x, fixed = TRUE)
    x
  }
}

# Sample-flow recorder for Table 1 (see section D). `key` is a stable id used
# by the Table 1 assembler; `step` is the human-readable row label.
flow <- tibble::tibble(key = character(), step = character(), n = integer(), note = character())
flow_add <- function(flow, key, step, n, note = "") {
  dplyr::bind_rows(flow, tibble::tibble(key = key, step = step, n = as.integer(n), note = note))
}

if (!dir.exists("tables")) dir.create("tables")
```

# Data Import

```{r data-import}
# File names: Study 1 as below; Study 2 uses ../data/Study_2_Pre_/Post_..._April22_2026.csv
pre_raw  <- read_csv("../data/Study1_Pre_Refugee_Attitude_Study_March_31_2026.csv")[-c(1, 2), ]
post_raw <- read_csv("../data/Study1_Post_Refugee_Attitude_Study_March_31_2026.csv")[-c(1, 2), ]
flow <- flow_add(flow, "qualtrics_pre_rows",  "Pre-survey responses recorded (Qualtrics rows, incl. incomplete/duplicate)",  nrow(pre_raw))
flow <- flow_add(flow, "qualtrics_post_rows", "Post-survey responses recorded (Qualtrics rows, incl. incomplete/duplicate)", nrow(post_raw))

# Diagnostics behind the "duplicates/incomplete" row of Table 1.
finished_ok <- function(x) toupper(as.character(x)) %in% c("TRUE", "1")
cat(sprintf(paste0("Pre : %d rows, %d not Finished, %d duplicated Prolific IDs\n",
                   "Post: %d rows, %d not Finished, %d duplicated Prolific IDs\n"),
            nrow(pre_raw),  sum(!finished_ok(pre_raw$Finished)),  sum(duplicated(pre_raw$PROLIFIC_PID)),
            nrow(post_raw), sum(!finished_ok(post_raw$Finished)), sum(duplicated(post_raw$PROLIFIC_PID))))

# The pipeline used for the manuscript keeps the FIRST row per Prolific ID
# without checking Finished (unlike the Study 3 follow-up script, which filters
# Finished == TRUE first). APPLY_FINISHED_FILTER <- TRUE drops unfinished rows
# before de-duplication. Keep FALSE to reproduce the reported N; if TRUE changes
# N, that is a genuine cleaning decision to report in Table 1.
APPLY_FINISHED_FILTER <- FALSE
pre  <- pre_raw
post <- post_raw
if (APPLY_FINISHED_FILTER) {
  pre  <- dplyr::filter(pre,  finished_ok(Finished))
  post <- dplyr::filter(post, finished_ok(Finished))
}
pre  <- dplyr::distinct(pre,  PROLIFIC_PID, .keep_all = TRUE)
post <- dplyr::distinct(post, PROLIFIC_PID, .keep_all = TRUE)
data <- dplyr::inner_join(pre, post, by = "PROLIFIC_PID")
flow <- flow_add(flow, "matched_unique", "Unique participants with matched pre- and post-survey", nrow(data),
                 note = if (APPLY_FINISHED_FILTER) "unfinished rows dropped before de-duplication"
                        else "first row per Prolific ID kept; Finished not checked")
n_kept_unfinished <- sum(!finished_ok(data$Finished.x) | !finished_ok(data$Finished.y))
cat(sprintf("Matched participants whose kept pre or post row is not marked Finished: %d\n", n_kept_unfinished))


PROLIFIC_EXPORT <- NA_character_     # <- actual file, or NA_character_
if (!is.na(PROLIFIC_EXPORT) && file.exists(PROLIFIC_EXPORT)) {
  prolific <- read_csv(PROLIFIC_EXPORT, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "_", .x))            # "Participant id" -> "Participant_id"
  status <- toupper(trimws(prolific$Status))
  flow <- flow_add(flow, "prolific_started",  "Prolific submissions started (all statuses)", nrow(prolific))
  flow <- flow_add(flow, "prolific_approved", "Prolific submissions approved or awaiting review",
                   sum(status %in% c("APPROVED", "AWAITING REVIEW")))
  bad_ids  <- prolific$Participant_id[status %in% c("RETURNED", "REJECTED", "TIMED-OUT", "TIMED OUT")]
  n_before <- nrow(data)
  data     <- dplyr::filter(data, !PROLIFIC_PID %in% bad_ids)
  flow <- flow_add(flow, "after_returned", "After removing submissions returned/rejected/timed out on Prolific",
                   nrow(data), note = sprintf("%d removed", n_before - nrow(data)))
} else {
  flow <- flow_add(flow, "after_returned", "After removing submissions returned/rejected/timed out on Prolific",
                   nrow(data), note = "no Prolific export supplied; nothing removed")
}
nrow(pre); nrow(post); nrow(data)
```

## Streamlined condition naming (matches the paper)

```{r}

condition_recode <- c(
  "interview" = "self_reflection",
  "flyer"     = "static_information"
)

# Display labels used in tables, captions, plot titles and facets.
condition_labels <- c(
  neutral            = "Neutral",
  debunking          = "Debunking",
  self_reflection    = "Interview",
  empathy            = "Empathy",
  roleplay           = "Roleplay",
  static_information = "Static Information"
)


condition_order <- c(
  "neutral", "debunking", "self_reflection",
  "empathy", "roleplay", "static_information"
)


treatment_order <- c("neutral", "debunking", "self_reflection",
                     "empathy", "roleplay")

# Canonical DV display labels (drop the legacy "Attitudes" label for DV1).
dv_labels <- c(
  DV1 = "Perceptions",
  DV2 = "Refugee Support",
  DV3 = "Policy Endorsement"
)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Group = dplyr::recode(Group, !!!condition_recode),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = condition_order)
  )
```

# Data Cleaning

```{r}
# anonymize IDs
data <- data %>%
  mutate(anon_id = paste0("P", row_number()))

#drop completely empty columns
data <- data %>% select(where(~ sum(!is.na(.)) > 2))

# Drop further unnecessary columns
cols_to_remove <- c(
  "Status.x", "Status.y",
  "IPAddress.x", "IPAddress.y",
  "Finished.x", "Finished.y",
  "RecordedDate.x", "RecordedDate.y",
  "ResponseId.x", "ResponseId.y",
  "LocationLatitude.x", "LocationLatitude.y",
  "LocationLongitude.x", "LocationLongitude.y",
  "DistributionChannel.x", "DistributionChannel.y",
  "UserLanguage.x", "UserLanguage.y",
  "Progress.x", "Progress.y",
  "STUDY_ID.x", "STUDY_ID.y",
  "SESSION_ID.x", "SESSION_ID.y", "BOT_TYPE"
)

data <- data %>%
  select(-any_of(cols_to_remove))

# Check group sizes
group_table <- data %>%
  count(Group) %>%
  arrange(Group)

group_table %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Condition", "n"),
        caption = "Sample Size per Experimental Condition") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
```

## Exclusions

```{r exclusions}
## 1. Attention check (embedded in pre- and post-survey; instructed response "Often")
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(attention_pass = (!is.na(attention_check.x) & attention_check.x == "Often") &
                                 (!is.na(attention_check.y) & attention_check.y == "Often"))
print(table(data$attention_pass, data$Group, useNA = "ifany"))
n_before <- nrow(data)
data <- dplyr::filter(data, attention_pass %in% TRUE)
flow <- flow_add(flow, "excl_attention",  "Excluded: failed attention check", n_before - nrow(data))
flow <- flow_add(flow, "after_attention", "After attention-check exclusion",  nrow(data))

## 2. Completion time < 1/3 of the condition-specific median
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    StartDate.x = na_if(StartDate.x, ""),
    EndDate.y   = na_if(EndDate.y, ""),
    StartDate.x = parse_date_time(StartDate.x, orders = c("Ymd HMS", "Y-m-d H:M:S", "m/d/Y H:M", "d.m.Y H:M:S")),
    EndDate.y   = parse_date_time(EndDate.y,   orders = c("Ymd HMS", "Y-m-d H:M:S", "m/d/Y H:M", "d.m.Y H:M:S")),
    total_time_min = as.numeric(difftime(EndDate.y, StartDate.x, units = "mins"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Group) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(threshold  = median(total_time_min, na.rm = TRUE) / 3,
                speed_flag = total_time_min < threshold) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
cat(sprintf("Participants with missing completion time: %d\n", sum(is.na(data$total_time_min))))
print(table(data$speed_flag, data$Group, useNA = "ifany"))
n_before <- nrow(data)
data <- dplyr::filter(data, speed_flag %in% FALSE)      # NA times are excluded too (as before); reported above
flow <- flow_add(flow, "excl_speed",  "Excluded: completion time < 1/3 of condition median", n_before - nrow(data))
flow <- flow_add(flow, "after_speed", "After completion-time exclusion", nrow(data))

## 3. Low-effort reflection (< 3 words in the mandatory open-ended item)
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(post_reflection      = as.character(post_reflection),
                reflection_wordcount = dplyr::coalesce(stringr::str_count(post_reflection, "\\w+"), 0L),
                low_effort           = reflection_wordcount < 3)
print(table(data$low_effort, data$Group, useNA = "ifany"))
n_before <- nrow(data)
data <- dplyr::filter(data, low_effort %in% FALSE)
flow <- flow_add(flow, "excl_loweffort",  "Excluded: fewer than three words in the reflection item", n_before - nrow(data))
flow <- flow_add(flow, "after_loweffort", "After low-effort exclusion", nrow(data))

## Final analytic sample
flow <- flow_add(flow, "final", "Final sample size", nrow(data))
stopifnot(nrow(data) == c("1" = 554L, "2" = 250L)[[STUDY_NUM]])   # guards against silent drift

print(dplyr::count(data, Group))
knitr::kable(flow, caption = sprintf("Study %s: sample flow (Supplement Table 1)", STUDY_NUM)) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
readr::write_csv(dplyr::mutate(flow, study = STUDY_NUM, order = dplyr::row_number()),
                 sprintf("tables/study%s_sample_flow.csv", STUDY_NUM))
```


# DV Construction

```{r}
# Convert all DV items to numeric
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("pre_attitudes"),  as.numeric),
    across(starts_with("post_attitudes"), as.numeric),
    across(starts_with("pre_support"),    as.numeric),
    across(starts_with("post_support"),   as.numeric),
    across(starts_with("pre_policy"),     as.numeric),
    across(starts_with("post_policy"),    as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  
  # Rescale everything to 0–1 
  mutate(
    # Perceptions: Likert 1–5
    across(starts_with("pre_attitudes"),  ~ rescale01(., 1, 5)),
    across(starts_with("post_attitudes"), ~ rescale01(., 1, 5)),
    
    # Support: 0–100 sliders
    across(starts_with("pre_support"),    ~ rescale01(., 0, 100)),
    across(starts_with("post_support"),   ~ rescale01(., 0, 100)),
    
    # Policy: 0–100 sliders
    across(starts_with("pre_policy"),     ~ rescale01(., 0, 100)),
    across(starts_with("post_policy"),    ~ rescale01(., 0, 100))
  ) %>%
  
  # Create DV indices
  mutate(
    DV1_pre  = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("pre_attitudes")),  na.rm = TRUE),
    DV1_post = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("post_attitudes")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    DV2_pre  = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("pre_support")),    na.rm = TRUE),
    DV2_post = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("post_support")),   na.rm = TRUE),
    
    DV3_pre  = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("pre_policy")),     na.rm = TRUE),
    DV3_post = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("post_policy")),    na.rm = TRUE)
  )



## Reliability (Cronbach's alpha)

# Compute alphas for each DV index (using item sets)
alpha_DV1_pre  <- psych::alpha(select(data, starts_with("pre_attitudes")))
alpha_DV1_post <- psych::alpha(select(data, starts_with("post_attitudes")))

alpha_DV2_pre  <- psych::alpha(select(data, starts_with("pre_support")))
alpha_DV2_post <- psych::alpha(select(data, starts_with("post_support")))

alpha_DV3_pre  <- psych::alpha(select(data, starts_with("pre_policy")))
alpha_DV3_post <- psych::alpha(select(data, starts_with("post_policy")))

# Build summary table (scale names follow the canonical DV labels used
# throughout the results -- Perceptions / Refugee Support / Policy
# Endorsement -- instead of the raw DV1/DV2/DV3 variable names)
reliability_summary <- tibble(
  Scale     = rep(c("Perceptions", "Refugee Support", "Policy Endorsement"), each = 2),
  Timepoint = rep(c("Pre", "Post"), times = 3),

  alpha = c(alpha_DV1_pre$total$raw_alpha,
            alpha_DV1_post$total$raw_alpha,
            alpha_DV2_pre$total$raw_alpha,
            alpha_DV2_post$total$raw_alpha,
            alpha_DV3_pre$total$raw_alpha,
            alpha_DV3_post$total$raw_alpha)
)


study1_reliability_summary_kbl <- reliability_summary %>%
  select(Timepoint, alpha) %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        col.names = c("Timepoint", "Cronbach's alpha"),
        caption = "Reliability Summary for Pre/Post Perceptions, Support, and Policy Scales",
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  kableExtra::pack_rows("Perceptions", 1, 2, hline_before = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::pack_rows("Refugee Support", 3, 4, hline_before = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::pack_rows("Policy Endorsement", 5, 6, hline_before = TRUE)

kableExtra::save_kable(
  study1_reliability_summary_kbl,
  file = "tables/study1_reliability_summary.tex"
)

# HTML version, shown inline in the knitted document
study1_reliability_summary_table <- reliability_summary %>%
  select(Timepoint, alpha) %>%
  kable(digits = 3,
        col.names = c("Timepoint", "Cronbach's alpha"),
        caption = "Reliability Summary for Pre/Post Perceptions, Support, and Policy Scales") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  pack_rows("Perceptions", 1, 2) %>%
  pack_rows("Refugee Support", 3, 4) %>%
  pack_rows("Policy Endorsement", 5, 6)

study1_reliability_summary_table

```

# Confirmatory Analysis

```{r}




data_treatments <- data %>%
  filter(Group != "static_information") %>%
  mutate(Group = droplevels(Group))

# PRE long data
pre_long <- data_treatments %>%
  select(anon_id, Group, DV1_pre, DV2_pre, DV3_pre) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("DV"),
    names_to = "DV",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(time = "Pre")

# POST long data
post_long <- data_treatments %>%
  select(anon_id, Group, DV1_post, DV2_post, DV3_post) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("DV"),
    names_to = "DV",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time = "Post",
    DV = case_when(
      DV == "DV1_post" ~ "DV1",
      DV == "DV2_post" ~ "DV2",
      DV == "DV3_post" ~ "DV3"
    )
  )

# Combine into long LMM dataset
lmm_data <- bind_rows(
  pre_long %>% mutate(DV = case_when(
    DV == "DV1_pre" ~ "DV1",
    DV == "DV2_pre" ~ "DV2",
    DV == "DV3_pre" ~ "DV3"
  )),
  post_long
) %>%
  mutate(
    time = factor(time, levels = c("Pre", "Post")),
    Group = factor(Group),
    Group = relevel(Group, ref = "neutral")
  )


# 2. FIT LMMs (must come BEFORE contrast extraction)

lmm_DV1 <- lmer(score ~ Group * time + (1 | anon_id),
                data = filter(lmm_data, DV == "DV1"))

lmm_DV2 <- lmer(score ~ Group * time + (1 | anon_id),
                data = filter(lmm_data, DV == "DV2"))

lmm_DV3 <- lmer(score ~ Group * time + (1 | anon_id),
                data = filter(lmm_data, DV == "DV3"))




one_sided_p <- function(p_two, estimate) {
  ifelse(estimate > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - p_two / 2)
}

sig_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p))   return("")
  if (p < 0.001)  return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)   return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)   return("*")
  if (p < 0.10)   return("dagger")
  return("")
}


term_labels <- c(
  "(Intercept)"                   = "Intercept (\\textsc{Neutral~1}, pre)",
  "timePost"                      = "Post",
  "Groupdebunking"                = "\\textsc{Debunking}",
  "Groupself_reflection"          = "\\textsc{Interview}",
  "Groupempathy"                  = "\\textsc{Empathy}",
  "Grouproleplay"                 = "\\textsc{Roleplay}",
  "Groupdebunking:timePost"       = "\\textsc{Debunking} \u00D7 Post",
  "Groupself_reflection:timePost" = "\\textsc{Interview} \u00D7 Post",
  "Groupempathy:timePost"         = "\\textsc{Empathy} \u00D7 Post",
  "Grouproleplay:timePost"        = "\\textsc{Roleplay} \u00D7 Post"
)


relabel_term <- function(term) {
  out <- unname(term_labels[term])
  out[is.na(out)] <- term[is.na(out)]
  out
}


group_display_labels <- c(
  neutral             = "\\textsc{Neutral}",
  debunking           = "\\textsc{Debunking}",
  self_reflection     = "\\textsc{Interview}",
  empathy             = "\\textsc{Empathy}",
  roleplay            = "\\textsc{Roleplay}",
  static_information  = "\\textsc{Static~Information}"
)

relabel_groups_in_string <- function(x) {
  keys <- names(group_display_labels)[order(-nchar(names(group_display_labels)))]
  for (key in keys) {
    x <- gsub(key, group_display_labels[[key]], x, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  x
}

# Holm-within-DV: applied across the 4 Group:timePost interaction contrasts.
holm_within_dv <- function(terms, p_vals) {
  is_target <- grepl("^Group.*:timePost$", terms)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(p_vals))
  out[is_target] <- p.adjust(p_vals[is_target], method = "holm")
  out
}

make_fixed_effects_table <- function(model) {
  anova(model) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Effect") %>%
    mutate(
      F = round(`F value`, 3),
      # Omnibus F-tests are non-directional; no one-sided version exists.
      p_value = round(`Pr(>F)`, 4),
      stars = map_chr(p_value, sig_stars)
    ) %>%
    select(Effect, NumDF, DenDF, F, p_value, stars)
}

make_coef_table <- function(model) {
  tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    mutate(
      p_one_raw   = one_sided_p(p.value, estimate),
      Estimate    = round(estimate, 3),
      SE          = round(std.error, 3),
      t           = round(statistic, 3),
      # p_one_raw is kept only as the input to the Holm correction below;
      # the uncorrected p-value is intentionally not exposed in the table.
      p_holm_within_dv = round(holm_within_dv(term, p_one_raw), 4),
      stars = map_chr(p_holm_within_dv, sig_stars),
      Term = relabel_term(term)
    ) %>%
    # Keep only the 4 Group:timePost interaction contrasts (the terms the
    # Holm correction above actually targets); drop Intercept, main
    # effects of Group, and the main effect of time.
    filter(grepl("^Group.*:timePost$", term)) %>%
    select(Term, Estimate, SE, t, p_holm_within_dv, stars)
}

# Tables
table_DV1_fixed <- make_fixed_effects_table(lmm_DV1)
table_DV1_coef  <- make_coef_table(lmm_DV1)

table_DV2_fixed <- make_fixed_effects_table(lmm_DV2)
table_DV2_coef  <- make_coef_table(lmm_DV2)

table_DV3_fixed <- make_fixed_effects_table(lmm_DV3)
table_DV3_coef  <- make_coef_table(lmm_DV3)


if (!dir.exists("tables")) {
  dir.create("tables")
}

save_fixed_effects_tex <- function(tbl, dv_key, file) {
  tbl %>%
    kable(
      digits = 3,
      caption = paste0(dv_labels[[dv_key]], " (", dv_key, "): Omnibus Fixed-Effects (Type III) Tests"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = file)
}

save_coef_tex <- function(tbl, dv_key, file) {
  tbl %>%
    kable(
      digits = 3,
      caption = paste0(dv_labels[[dv_key]], " (", dv_key, "): Fixed-Effect Coefficients (One-Sided, Holm-within-DV)"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = file)
}

save_fixed_effects_tex(table_DV1_fixed, "DV1", "tables/study1_dv1_fixed_effects.tex")
save_coef_tex(table_DV1_coef, "DV1", "tables/study1_dv1_coefficients.tex")

extract_contrasts <- function(model, dv_name) {
  broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(grepl("Group.*:timePost", term)) %>%
    mutate(
      DV          = dv_labels[[dv_name]],
      Estimate    = estimate,
      SE          = std.error,
      t           = statistic,
      CI_low      = conf.low,        # 95% Wald interval, unadjusted (as in Study 2)
      CI_high     = conf.high,
      p_two_sided = p.value,
      p_one_sided = one_sided_p(p.value, estimate),
      term        = relabel_term(term)
    ) %>%
    select(DV, term, Estimate, SE, t, CI_low, CI_high, p_two_sided, p_one_sided)
}

apply_holm <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      p_holm_within_dv = p.adjust(p_one_sided, method = "holm"),
      stars = case_when(
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.10  ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
}

contr_DV1 <- apply_holm(extract_contrasts(lmm_DV1, "DV1"))
contr_DV2 <- apply_holm(extract_contrasts(lmm_DV2, "DV2"))
contr_DV3 <- apply_holm(extract_contrasts(lmm_DV3, "DV3"))

print_contrast_table <- function(df, title) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Estimate         = round(Estimate, 3),
      SE               = round(SE, 3),
      t                = round(t, 3),
      p_holm_within_dv = round(p_holm_within_dv, 4)
    ) %>%

    select(DV, Term = term, Estimate, SE, t, p_holm_within_dv, stars) %>%
    kable(digits = 3, caption = title) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
}

save_contrast_table_tex <- function(df, caption, label, file) {

    transmute(Term = term,
              Estimate = sprintf("%.3f", Estimate), SE = sprintf("%.3f", SE), `$t$` = sprintf("%.3f", t),
              `LB$_{95}$` = sprintf("%.3f", CI_low), `UB$_{95}$` = sprintf("%.3f", CI_high),
```

```{r between-intervention-change}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Differences between interventions in pre-post change

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pair_order <- c("self_reflection - debunking", "empathy - debunking",
                "empathy - self_reflection",   "roleplay - debunking",
                "roleplay - self_reflection",  "roleplay - empathy")

between_intervention_change <- function(model, dv_key, holm_family = c("six", "ten")) {
  holm_family <- match.arg(holm_family)
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(model, ~ Group * time)
  # "revpairwise" on both factors gives (later level - earlier level) of
  # (Post - Pre): a positive estimate means the first-named condition improved
  # more. Factor order is neutral, debunking, self_reflection, empathy, roleplay.
  ic  <- emmeans::contrast(emm, interaction = c(Group = "revpairwise", time = "revpairwise"))
  tab <- as.data.frame(summary(ic, adjust = "none", infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
  grp_col <- grep("^Group", names(tab), value = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(grp_col) == 1)
  tab <- dplyr::rename(tab, pair = !!rlang::sym(grp_col))
  if (holm_family == "six") tab <- dplyr::filter(tab, !grepl("neutral", pair))
  tab <- dplyr::mutate(tab, p_holm = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"))
  stopifnot(nrow(tab) == ifelse(holm_family == "six", 6L, 10L))

  # Identity check: each estimate equals the difference of the two Group:timePost
  # fixed effects (Neutral is the reference; its interaction coefficient is 0).
  fe <- lme4::fixef(model)
  coef_of <- function(g) if (g == "neutral") 0 else unname(fe[[paste0("Group", g, ":timePost")]])
  lhs <- sub(" - .*$", "", tab$pair)
  rhs <- sub("^.* - ", "", tab$pair)
  expected <- mapply(function(a, b) coef_of(a) - coef_of(b), lhs, rhs)
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(expected), tab$estimate, tolerance = 1e-8)))

  tab %>%
    dplyr::arrange(match(pair, pair_order)) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      DV       = dv_labels[[dv_key]],
      pair,
      Contrast = relabel_groups_in_string(pair),
      Estimate = estimate, SE, df, t = t.ratio,
      p_holm, CI_low = lower.CL, CI_high = upper.CL,
      stars    = stars3(p_holm)
    )
}

bic_DV1 <- between_intervention_change(lmm_DV1, "DV1")
bic_DV2 <- between_intervention_change(lmm_DV2, "DV2")
bic_DV3 <- between_intervention_change(lmm_DV3, "DV3")

show_bic <- function(tbl, dv_key) {
  tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(Estimate, SE, t, CI_low, CI_high), ~ round(., 3)),
                  df = round(df, 0), p_holm = round(p_holm, 4)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Contrast, Estimate, SE, df, t, p_holm, CI_low, CI_high, stars) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = sprintf(
      "%s: differences between interventions in pre-post change (Study %s; contrasts of the Condition x Time interaction; two-sided; Holm across the six intervention pairs; 95%% CIs unadjusted)",
      dv_labels[[dv_key]], STUDY_NUM)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
}
show_bic(bic_DV1, "DV1"); show_bic(bic_DV2, "DV2"); show_bic(bic_DV3, "DV3")

# ---- LaTeX export (Supplement F.3 / G.3) ------------------------------------
export_bic <- function(tbl, dv_key) {
  out <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Contrast,
      Estimate = sprintf("%.3f", Estimate), SE = sprintf("%.3f", SE),
      df = sprintf("%.0f", df), t = sprintf("%.3f", t),
      p_holm  = fmt_p3(p_holm),
      CI_low  = sprintf("%.3f", CI_low), CI_high = sprintf("%.3f", CI_high),
      stars   = stars_tex(stars))
  knitr::kable(out, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
               label = sprintf("%s-%s-change", STUDY_TAG, tolower(dv_key)),   # -> \label{tab:s1-dv2-change}
               col.names = c("Contrast", "Estimate", "SE", "$df$", "$t$",
                             "$p_{\\mathrm{Holm}}$", "LB$_{95}$", "UB$_{95}$", "Sig."),
               caption = sprintf(paste0(
                 "%s: differences between interventions in pre--post change in Study~%s ",
                 "(contrasts of the Condition $\\times$ Time interaction; two-sided; ",
                 "Holm-corrected across the six intervention pairs; 95\\%% confidence intervals unadjusted). ",
                 "$^{\\dagger}p<.10$, $^{*}p<.05$, $^{**}p<.01$, $^{***}p<.001$."),
                 dv_labels[[dv_key]], STUDY_NUM)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center", latex_options = "scale_down") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = sprintf("tables/study%s_%s_between_intervention_change.tex",
                                          STUDY_NUM, tolower(dv_key)))
}
export_bic(bic_DV1, "DV1"); export_bic(bic_DV2, "DV2"); export_bic(bic_DV3, "DV3")

# ---- manuscript-ready sentences (p.p. = 100 x estimate on the 0-1 scale) -----
bic_sentence <- function(tbl) {
  tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(txt = sprintf("%s: %.1f p.p., 95%% CI [%.1f, %.1f], p_Holm %s",
                                gsub("\\\\textsc\\{|\\}", "", Contrast),
                                100 * Estimate, 100 * CI_low, 100 * CI_high, p_txt(p_holm))) %>%
    dplyr::pull(txt)
}

}
```

## Effect Sizes (Cohen's d for the treatment-vs-Neutral pre-post contrasts)



```{r}
make_cohens_d_table <- function(model, dv_name) {
  vc       <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
  sd_total <- sqrt(sum(vc$vcov))
  sd_resid <- sigma(model)
  sd_pre   <- sd(filter(lmm_data, DV == dv_name, time == "Pre")$score,
                 na.rm = TRUE)

  broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(grepl("^Group.*:timePost$", term)) %>%
    transmute(
      # Canonical DV label rather than the raw DV1/DV2/DV3 tag (dv_name is
      # still used above, unmodified, to filter the raw lmm_data).
      DV        = dv_labels[[dv_name]],
      Contrast  = unname(group_display_labels[sub(":timePost", "", sub("^Group", "", term))]),
      Estimate  = estimate,
      d_pre_sd  = estimate / sd_pre,    # Morris (2008) d_ppc2 (primary)
      d_total_sd = estimate / sd_total, # total person-level SD
      d_resid_sd = estimate / sd_resid  # within-person (residual) SD
    )
}

cohens_d_table <- bind_rows(
  make_cohens_d_table(lmm_DV1, "DV1"),
  make_cohens_d_table(lmm_DV2, "DV2"),
  make_cohens_d_table(lmm_DV3, "DV3")
)

cohens_d_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Cohen's d for the Group x timePost contrasts (primary: d_pre_sd = diff-in-diff / pooled pre-intervention SD, Morris 2008 d_ppc2)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
```

```{r}

lmm_data <- lmm_data %>%
  mutate(
    score_original = case_when(
      DV == "DV1" ~ score * 4 + 1,      # 0–1 → 1–5
      DV == "DV2" ~ score * 100,        # 0–1 → 0–100
      DV == "DV3" ~ score * 100,        # 0–1 → 0–100
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(patchwork)

desired_order <- c("neutral", "self_reflection", "empathy", "roleplay", "debunking")  # Debunking moved to the end

dv_scales <- list(
  DV1 = c(1, 5),
  DV2 = c(0, 100),
  DV3 = c(0, 100)
)

dv_plot_labels <- list(
  DV1 = "Perceptions",
  DV2 = "Refugee Support",
  DV3 = "Policy Endorsement"
)

facet_labels <- c(
  neutral         = "Neutral",
  self_reflection = "Interview",
  empathy         = "Empathy",
  roleplay        = "Roleplay",
  debunking       = "Debunking"
)

plot_dv <- function(dv_name, show_n = FALSE) {
  
  df <- lmm_data %>%
    filter(DV == dv_name) %>%
    mutate(
      Group_plot  = factor(Group, levels = desired_order),
      time        = factor(time, levels = c("Pre", "Post")),
      Group_model = relevel(factor(Group), ref = "neutral")
    )
  
  sum_sub <- df %>%
    group_by(Group_plot, time) %>%
    summarise(
      mean  = mean(score_original),
      sd    = sd(score_original),
      n     = n(),
      se    = sd / sqrt(n),
      lower = mean - 1.96 * se,
      upper = mean + 1.96 * se,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  

  if (show_n) {
    n_lookup <- sum_sub %>%
      filter(time == "Pre") %>%
      select(Group_plot, n) %>%
      deframe()
    
    facet_labels_use <- setNames(
      paste0(facet_labels[names(facet_labels)],
             "\n(n = ", n_lookup[names(facet_labels)], ")"),
      names(facet_labels)
    )
  } else {
    facet_labels_use <- facet_labels
  }
  
  model <- lmer(score ~ Group_model * time + (1 | anon_id), data = df)
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
  
  # --- NON-NEUTRAL GROUPS: interaction terms ---
  rows  <- grep("^Group_model.*:timePost$", rownames(coefs))
  
  sig_sub_nonneutral <- tibble(
    Group_model = sub("Group_model", "", sub(":timePost", "", rownames(coefs)[rows])),
    est         = coefs[rows, "Estimate"],
    p_two       = coefs[rows, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Primary specification: one-sided p-values (H1: estimate > 0), Holm
      # correction across the 4 treatment-vs-Neutral contrasts within this DV.
      p_one            = one_sided_p(p_two, est),
      p_holm_within_dv = p.adjust(p_one, method = "holm"),
      Group_plot = factor(Group_model, levels = desired_order),
      star = case_when(
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.10  ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      est_fmt = sprintf("%.3f", est),
      p_fmt   = sprintf("%.3f", p_holm_within_dv),
      label_expr = map2(
        est_fmt, p_fmt,
        ~ bquote(Delta == .( .x ) ~ "(" * italic(p) == .( .y ) * ")")
      )
    )
  
  # --- NEUTRAL GROUP: force Δ = 0 and p = 1 ---
  neutral_row <- tibble(
    Group_model      = "neutral",
    est              = 0,
    p_two            = 1,
    p_one            = 1,
    p_holm_within_dv = 1,
    Group_plot       = factor("neutral", levels = desired_order),
    star             = "",
    est_fmt          = sprintf("%.3f", 0),
    p_fmt            = sprintf("%.3f", 1),
    label_expr  = map2(
      est_fmt, p_fmt,
      ~ bquote(Delta == .( .x ) ~ "(" * italic(p) == .( .y ) * ")")
    )
  )
  
  # combine neutral + non-neutral
  sig_sub <- bind_rows(neutral_row, sig_sub_nonneutral)
  
  y_limits <- dv_scales[[dv_name]]
  
  cond_colors <- c(
    "neutral.Pre"          = "#d9d9d9",
    "neutral.Post"         = "#737373",
    "self_reflection.Pre"  = "#a6cee3",
    "self_reflection.Post" = "#1f78b4",
    "empathy.Pre"          = "#fca5a5",
    "empathy.Post"         = "#e31a1c",
    "roleplay.Pre"         = "#b2df8a",
    "roleplay.Post"        = "#33a02c",
    "debunking.Pre"        = "#cfcfcf",
    "debunking.Post"       = "#5f5f5f"
  )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = score_original,
                 fill = interaction(Group_plot, time))) +
    
    # LEFT SIDE: Replaced with ggdist::stat_slab
    stat_slab(
      data = df %>% filter(time == "Pre"),
      side = "left", trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.85, color = NA
    ) +
    
    # RIGHT SIDE: Replaced with ggdist::stat_slab
    stat_slab(
      data = df %>% filter(time == "Post"),
      side = "right", trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.85, color = NA
    ) + 
    
    geom_line(
      data = sum_sub,
      aes(y = mean, group = Group_plot),
      linewidth = 1.1,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_point(
      data = sum_sub,
      aes(y = mean),
      size = 2.2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_errorbar(
      data = sum_sub,
      aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, y = mean),
      width = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = sig_sub,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = star),
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold",
      vjust = 3,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = sig_sub,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label_expr),
      parse = TRUE,
      size = 3.2,
      vjust = 1.4,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Group_plot,
      nrow = 1,
      labeller = labeller(Group_plot = facet_labels_use),
      strip.position = "top"
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors) +
    labs(x = "", y = dv_plot_labels[[dv_name]]) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
    ) +
    
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )
}

p1 <- plot_dv("DV1", show_n = TRUE)
p2 <- plot_dv("DV2")
p3 <- plot_dv("DV3")

stacked <- p1 / p2 / p3 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")

ggsave("Confirmatory_Stacked_Figure.pdf", stacked, width = 10, height = 13)
```

# Additional comparison group: Static Information as reference category


```{r}


make_fixed_effects_table <- function(model) {
  anova(model) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Effect") %>%
    mutate(
      F                = round(`F value`, 3),
      # Omnibus F-tests are non-directional; no one-sided version exists.
      # Only the Holm-corrected p-value is exposed in the table.
      p_value_raw      = `Pr(>F)`,
      p_holm_raw       = p.adjust(p_value_raw, method = "holm"),
      p_holm_within_dv = sprintf("%.3f", p_holm_raw),
      stars = case_when(
        p_holm_raw < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_holm_raw < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_holm_raw < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_holm_raw < 0.10  ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      Effect, NumDF, DenDF, F,
      p_holm_within_dv, stars
    )
}


term_labels_static <- c(
  "(Intercept)"                   = "Intercept (\\textsc{Static~Information}, pre)",
  "timePost"                      = "Post",
  "Groupneutral"                  = "\\textsc{Neutral}",
  "Groupdebunking"                = "\\textsc{Debunking}",
  "Groupself_reflection"          = "\\textsc{Interview}",
  "Groupempathy"                  = "\\textsc{Empathy}",
  "Grouproleplay"                 = "\\textsc{Roleplay}",
  "Groupneutral:timePost"         = "\\textsc{Neutral} \u00D7 Post",
  "Groupdebunking:timePost"       = "\\textsc{Debunking} \u00D7 Post",
  "Groupself_reflection:timePost" = "\\textsc{Interview} \u00D7 Post",
  "Groupempathy:timePost"         = "\\textsc{Empathy} \u00D7 Post",
  "Grouproleplay:timePost"        = "\\textsc{Roleplay} \u00D7 Post"
)

relabel_term_static <- function(term) {
  out <- unname(term_labels_static[term])
  out[is.na(out)] <- term[is.na(out)]
  out
}

make_coef_table <- function(model) {
  tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      is_contrast      = grepl("^Group.*:timePost$", term),
      p_one_sided_raw  = one_sided_p(p.value, estimate),
      p_holm_raw       = ifelse(is_contrast,
                                p.adjust(ifelse(is_contrast, p_one_sided_raw, NA_real_), method = "holm"),
                                NA_real_),
      Estimate         = sprintf("%.3f", estimate),
      SE               = sprintf("%.3f", std.error),
      t                = sprintf("%.3f", statistic),
      CI_low           = sprintf("%.3f", conf.low),
      CI_high          = sprintf("%.3f", conf.high),
      p_holm_within_dv = ifelse(is.na(p_holm_raw), "",
                                ifelse(p_holm_raw < 0.001, "$<$0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_holm_raw))),
      stars = case_when(
        !is.na(p_holm_raw) & p_holm_raw < 0.001 ~ "***",
        !is.na(p_holm_raw) & p_holm_raw < 0.01  ~ "**",
        !is.na(p_holm_raw) & p_holm_raw < 0.05  ~ "*",
        !is.na(p_holm_raw) & p_holm_raw < 0.10  ~ "$\\dagger$",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      Term = relabel_term_static(term)
    ) %>%
    select(Term, Estimate, SE, t, CI_low, CI_high, p_holm_within_dv, stars)
}

table_DV2_coef_static  <- make_coef_table(lmm_DV2_static)

table_DV3_fixed_static <- make_fixed_effects_table(lmm_DV3_static)
table_DV3_coef_static  <- make_coef_table(lmm_DV3_static)


# OUTPUT

save_fixed_effects_tex_static <- function(tbl, dv_key, file) {
  tbl %>%
    kable(
      digits = 3,
      caption = paste0(dv_labels[[dv_key]], " (", dv_key, "): Omnibus Fixed-Effects (Type III) Tests, Static Information Reference"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = file)
}

save_coef_tex_static <- function(tbl, dv_key, study_num, file) {
  stopifnot(identical(names(tbl), c("Term", "Estimate", "SE", "t", "CI_low", "CI_high", "p_holm_within_dv", "stars")))
  tbl %>%
    kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
          label = sprintf("s%s-%s-static", study_num, tolower(dv_key)),
          col.names = c("Term", "Estimate", "SE", "$t$", "LB$_{95}$", "UB$_{95}$", "$p_{\\mathrm{Holm}}$", "Sig."),
          caption = sprintf(paste0(
            "%s: robustness coefficients in Study~%s (linear mixed-effects model with \\textsc{Static Information} ",
            "as the reference condition; 95\\%% confidence intervals unadjusted; $p$ one-sided and Holm-corrected across ",
            "the five Condition $\\times$ Post contrasts and reported for those contrasts only). ",
            "$^{\\dagger}p<.10$, $^{*}p<.05$, $^{**}p<.01$, $^{***}p<.001$."), dv_labels[[dv_key]], study_num)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center", latex_options = "scale_down") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = file)
}

save_fixed_effects_tex_static(table_DV1_fixed_static, "DV1", "tables/study1_dv1_fixed_effects_static_ref.tex")
save_coef_tex_static(table_DV1_coef_static, "DV1", "1", "tables/study1_dv1_coefficients_static_ref.tex")

save_fixed_effects_tex_static(table_DV2_fixed_static, "DV2", "tables/study1_dv2_fixed_effects_static_ref.tex")
save_coef_tex_static(table_DV2_coef_static, "DV2", "1", "tables/study1_dv2_coefficients_static_ref.tex")

save_fixed_effects_tex_static(table_DV3_fixed_static, "DV3", "tables/study1_dv3_fixed_effects_static_ref.tex")
```

# Exploratory Analyses

## Demographics

### Demographics cleaning

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    # age: collapse into 3 groups + unknown
    age3 = case_when(
      age %in% c("18-24", "25-34") ~ "young",
      age %in% c("35-44", "45-54") ~ "middle",
      age %in% c("55-64", "65 or older") ~ "older",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    age3 = factor(age3, levels = c("young", "middle", "older", "unknown")),

    # gender: collapse tiny categories
    gender3 = case_when(
      gender == "Male" ~ "Male",
      gender == "Female" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    gender3 = factor(gender3, levels = c("Male", "Female", "Other")),

    # employment: collapse multi-select chaos
    employment3 = case_when(
      grepl("full-time", employment, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Full-time",
      grepl("part-time|student", employment, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Part-time/Student",
      TRUE ~ "Other/Not working"
    ),
    employment3 = factor(
      employment3,
      levels = c("Full-time", "Part-time/Student", "Other/Not working")
    ),

    # children: binary
    children_bin = ifelse(children == "0", "No children", "Has children"),
    children_bin = factor(children_bin, levels = c("No children", "Has children")),

    # economic situation: keep as is
    economic_situation = factor(
      economic_situation,
      levels = c("Low income", "Middle income", "High income", "Prefer not to say")
    ),

    # religion: collapse into 3 groups
    religion3 = case_when(
      religion == "No religious affiliation" ~ "None",
      religion == "Christianity" ~ "Christian",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    religion3 = factor(religion3, levels = c("None", "Christian", "Other")),

    # migration background: keep as is
    migration_background = factor(
      migration_background,
      levels = c("Yes", "No", "Prefer not to say")
    ),

    # sliders: numeric + z-score
    contact_1 = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", contact_1)),
    political_view_1 = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", political_view_1)),
    contact_1_z = as.numeric(scale(contact_1)),
    political_view_1_z = as.numeric(scale(political_view_1))
  )

# Quick summaries
summary(data$age3)
summary(data$gender3)
summary(data$employment3)
summary(data$children_bin)
summary(data$religion3)
```

## Pairwise comparisons among treatment conditions

```{r}


make_pairwise_table <- function(df, facet = c("none", "time", "group")) {
  facet <- match.arg(facet)

  out <- df %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      p_one_raw        = one_sided_p(p.value, estimate),
      p_holm_within_dv = p.adjust(p_one_raw, method = "holm"),
      Contrast         = relabel_groups_in_string(contrast),
      stars = case_when(
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_holm_within_dv < 0.10  ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      Estimate         = sprintf("%.3f", estimate),
      SE               = sprintf("%.3f", SE),
      df               = sprintf("%.1f", df),
      t                = sprintf("%.3f", t.ratio),
      p_holm_within_dv = sprintf("%.3f", p_holm_within_dv)
    )

  if (facet == "time") {
    out <- out %>% mutate(Time = as.character(time))
    out %>% select(Time, Contrast, Estimate, SE, df, t, p_holm_within_dv, stars)
  } else if (facet == "group") {
    out <- out %>% mutate(Group = unname(group_display_labels[as.character(Group)]))
    out %>% select(Group, Contrast, Estimate, SE, df, t, p_holm_within_dv, stars)
  } else {
    out %>% select(Contrast, Estimate, SE, df, t, p_holm_within_dv, stars)
  }
}

save_pairwise_table_tex <- function(tbl, caption, file) {
  tbl %>%
    kable(
      digits = 3,
      caption = caption,
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = file)
}
```

## Bot-Perception analysis

```{r}
# CONDITION COLORS
condition_colors <- c(
  neutral         = "#737373",
  debunking       = "#5f5f5f",
  self_reflection = "#1f78b4",
  empathy         = "#e31a1c",
  roleplay        = "#33a02c"
)


desired_order <- treatment_order


# DATA PREP

data_perc <- data %>%
  filter(Group != "static_information") %>%
  mutate(
    Group = droplevels(Group),
    bot_perception_1 = as.numeric(bot_perception_1),
    bot_perception_2 = as.numeric(bot_perception_2),
    bot_perception_3 = as.numeric(bot_perception_3),
    perceived_empathy    = bot_perception_1 / 100,
    perceived_pleasure   = bot_perception_2 / 100,
    perceived_reflection = bot_perception_3 / 100,
    bot_perception_1_01  = perceived_empathy,
    bot_perception_2_01  = perceived_pleasure,
    bot_perception_3_01  = perceived_reflection
  )


# DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS

perception_desc <- data_perc %>% 
  group_by(Group) %>% 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_empathy = mean(bot_perception_1_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_empathy = sd(bot_perception_1_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pleasure = mean(bot_perception_2_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pleasure = sd(bot_perception_2_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_reflection = mean(bot_perception_3_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_reflection = sd(bot_perception_3_01, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

perception_desc %>% 
  kable(digits = 3,
        caption = "Bot-Perception Scores by Condition (chatbot conditions only; Static Information held out)") %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)


# MEANS + SEs

perc_summary <- data_perc %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    empathy_mean = mean(bot_perception_1_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    empathy_se   = sd(bot_perception_1_01, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    pleasure_mean = mean(bot_perception_2_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    pleasure_se   = sd(bot_perception_2_01, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    reflection_mean = mean(bot_perception_3_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    reflection_se   = sd(bot_perception_3_01, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )


# BARPLOTS 

ggplot(perc_summary, aes(x = Group, y = empathy_mean, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = empathy_mean - empathy_se,
                    ymax = empathy_mean + empathy_se),
                width = .2) +
  labs(title = "Perceived Empathy by Condition",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(perc_summary, aes(x = Group, y = pleasure_mean, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pleasure_mean - pleasure_se,
                    ymax = pleasure_mean + pleasure_se),
                width = .2) +
  labs(title = "Perceived Pleasure by Condition",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(perc_summary, aes(x = Group, y = reflection_mean, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = reflection_mean - reflection_se,
```

```{r botperception-export}


if (!dir.exists("tables")) dir.create("tables")

bp_dims <- tibble::tribble(
  ~dim,         ~var,                  ~label,
  "empathy",    "bot_perception_1_01", "Perceived Empathy",
  "pleasure",   "bot_perception_2_01", "Perceived Pleasure",
  "reflection", "bot_perception_3_01", "Perceived Reflection"
)

# Same three models as above, same 0-1 items, no covariates.
model_perc_empathy    <- lm(bot_perception_1_01 ~ Group, data = data_perc)
model_perc_pleasure   <- lm(bot_perception_2_01 ~ Group, data = data_perc)
model_perc_reflection <- lm(bot_perception_3_01 ~ Group, data = data_perc)

bp_models <- list(empathy    = model_perc_empathy,
                  pleasure   = model_perc_pleasure,
                  reflection = model_perc_reflection)
bp_emms  <- lapply(bp_models, function(m) emmeans(m, ~ Group))
# adjust = "holm" on the default two-sided pairwise contrasts.
bp_pairs <- lapply(bp_emms, function(e) contrast(e, method = "pairwise", adjust = "holm"))

bp_label <- function(suffix) paste0(STUDY_TAG, "-bp-", suffix)
bp_note  <- paste("Items are rescaled to 0--1. Static Information is held out because",
                  "participants in that condition did not interact with a chatbot.")

# DESCRIPTIVES -> tables/study1_botperception_descriptives.tex
bp_desc_tbl <- perception_desc %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = treatment_order)) %>%
  arrange(Group) %>%
  transmute(
    Condition  = unname(group_display_labels[as.character(Group)]),
    n          = as.integer(n),
    Empathy    = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_empathy, sd_empathy),
    Pleasure   = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_pleasure, sd_pleasure),
    Reflection = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_reflection, sd_reflection)
  )

bp_desc_tbl %>%
  kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
        label = bp_label("desc"),
        align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
        col.names = c("Condition", "$n$", "Empathy", "Pleasure", "Reflection"),
        caption = paste("Study 1 manipulation check: bot-perception ratings by condition,",
                        "reported as $M$ ($SD$).", bp_note)) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  kableExtra::save_kable(file = "tables/study1_botperception_descriptives.tex")

# OMNIBUS F-TESTS -> tables/study1_botperception_omnibus.tex
# eta^2 = SS_Group / SS_total, which for these one-way models equals R^2.
bp_omnibus_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(bp_dims$dim, function(d) {
  a <- anova(bp_models[[d]])
  tibble::tibble(
    Dimension = bp_dims$label[bp_dims$dim == d],
    df1  = a["Group", "Df"],
    df2  = a["Residuals", "Df"],
    Fval = a["Group", "F value"],
    eta2 = a["Group", "Sum Sq"] / sum(a[, "Sum Sq"]),
    pval = a["Group", "Pr(>F)"]
  )
})) %>%
  transmute(
    Dimension,
    df1   = sprintf("%d", as.integer(df1)),
    df2   = sprintf("%d", as.integer(df2)),
    F     = sprintf("%.3f", Fval),
    eta2  = sprintf("%.3f", eta2),
    p     = fmt_p3(pval),
    stars = stars_tex(stars3(pval))
  )

bp_omnibus_tbl %>%
  kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
        label = bp_label("omnibus"),
        align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l"),
        col.names = c("Dimension", "$df_1$", "$df_2$", "$F$", "$\\eta^2$", "$p$", ""),
        caption = paste("Study 1 manipulation check: omnibus tests of the condition effect on each",
                        "bot-perception dimension.", bp_note)) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  kableExtra::save_kable(file = "tables/study1_botperception_omnibus.tex")

# PER-DIMENSION EMMEANS AND TWO-SIDED HOLM PAIRWISE CONTRASTS
bp_emm_tbl <- function(emm) {
  as.data.frame(emm) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = treatment_order)) %>%
    arrange(Group) %>%
    transmute(
      Condition = unname(group_display_labels[as.character(Group)]),
      Estimate  = sprintf("%.3f", emmean),
      SE        = sprintf("%.3f", SE),
      df        = sprintf("%.0f", df),
      CI        = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", lower.CL, upper.CL)
    )
}

bp_pair_tbl <- function(ct) {
  as.data.frame(ct) %>%
    transmute(
      Contrast = relabel_groups_in_string(as.character(contrast)),
      Estimate = sprintf("%.3f", estimate),
      SE       = sprintf("%.3f", SE),
      df       = sprintf("%.0f", df),
      t        = sprintf("%.3f", t.ratio),
      p        = fmt_p3(p.value),
      stars    = stars_tex(stars3(p.value))
    )
}

for (d in bp_dims$dim) {
  dim_label <- bp_dims$label[bp_dims$dim == d]

  bp_emm_tbl(bp_emms[[d]]) %>%
    kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
          label = bp_label(paste0(d, "-emm")),
          align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
          col.names = c("Condition", "$M$", "$SE$", "$df$", "95\\% CI"),
          caption = paste0("Study 1 manipulation check: estimated marginal means for ",
                           dim_label, ". ", bp_note)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = sprintf("tables/study1_botperception_%s_emmeans.tex", d))

  bp_pair_tbl(bp_pairs[[d]]) %>%
    kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
          label = bp_label(paste0(d, "-pairwise")),
          align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l"),
          col.names = c("Contrast", "Estimate", "$SE$", "$df$", "$t$", "$p_{\\text{Holm}}$", ""),
          caption = paste0("Study 1 manipulation check: pairwise contrasts for ", dim_label,
                           ". Two-sided $t$-tests, Holm-corrected within dimension. ", bp_note)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    kableExtra::save_kable(file = sprintf("tables/study1_botperception_%s_pairwise.tex", d))
}

# GUARDS
# 1. Every contrast must equal the difference of the two estimated marginal
#    means it names, so the exported tables cannot silently disagree with the
#    emmeans tables next to them.
bp_contrast_gap <- function(emm, ct) {
  mu    <- as.data.frame(emm)
  mu    <- setNames(mu$emmean, as.character(mu$Group))
  cd    <- as.data.frame(ct)
  parts <- strsplit(as.character(cd$contrast), " - ", fixed = TRUE)
  stopifnot(all(lengths(parts) == 2),
            all(unlist(parts) %in% names(mu)))
  expected <- vapply(parts, function(p) mu[[p[1]]] - mu[[p[2]]], numeric(1))
  max(abs(cd$estimate - expected))
}
bp_gaps <- vapply(bp_dims$dim, function(d) bp_contrast_gap(bp_emms[[d]], bp_pairs[[d]]), numeric(1))
stopifnot(all(bp_gaps < 1e-8))

# 2. A large |t| with a p-value above .5 is the signature of the one-sided
#    helper that produced the old tables (it left the "wrong tail" contrasts
#    with p near 1). Two-sided tests can never do this.
bp_all_pairs <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(bp_dims$dim, function(d) {
  as.data.frame(bp_pairs[[d]]) %>% mutate(dim = d)
}))
stopifnot(!any(abs(bp_all_pairs$t.ratio) > 3 & bp_all_pairs$p.value > 0.5))

cat(sprintf(paste0("Bot-perception exports written to tables/ (8 files).\n",
                   "Guard 1: max |contrast - EMM difference| = %.2e\n",
                   "Guard 2: contrasts with |t| > 3 and p > 0.5 = %d\n"),
            max(bp_gaps),
            sum(abs(bp_all_pairs$t.ratio) > 3 & bp_all_pairs$p.value > 0.5)))
```

```{r exploratory-engagement-robustness, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)

# 1. LOAD CHATBOT LOG
# Path is relative to the Rmd's working directory (study_1/analysis/).
chat_log <- readxl::read_excel("../data/Chatbot_data_collection_March_31_2026.xlsx")

if (!inherits(chat_log$timestamp, "POSIXct")) {
  chat_log$timestamp <- lubridate::ymd_hms(chat_log$timestamp, quiet = TRUE)
}


system_markers <- c("Flyer content shown", "Flyer completed", "")

is_system_prompt <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\s*You are a", x) & nchar(x) > 1000
}

# The filtered log is kept as its own object so the log-integrity figures
# below are computed from it rather than typed.
chat_log_eng <- chat_log %>%
  filter(condition != "flyer",
         !is.na(prolific_pid), prolific_pid != "",
         !is.na(user_message), !user_message %in% system_markers)

n_system_prompt_rows <- sum(is_system_prompt(chat_log_eng$user_message))

engagement_sessions <- chat_log_eng %>%
  group_by(prolific_pid, session_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sess_turns  = sum(!is_system_prompt(user_message)),
    sess_rows   = n(),
    sess_opener = any(is_system_prompt(user_message)),
    sess_duration = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                        min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                        units = "mins")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(sess_duration = if_else(sess_rows > 1, sess_duration, NA_real_))

engagement <- engagement_sessions %>%
  group_by(prolific_pid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_turns           = sum(sess_turns),
    chat_duration_min = if (all(is.na(sess_duration))) NA_real_
                        else sum(sess_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Engagement is only a verifiable dose if every session opener survived
    # and every session yielded a usable interval.
    log_complete      = all(sess_opener) & !any(is.na(sess_duration)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(PROLIFIC_PID = prolific_pid) %>%
  mutate(
    n_turns_nz      = ifelse(n_turns > 0, n_turns, NA_real_)
  )

engagement_prev <- chat_log_eng %>%
  group_by(prolific_pid, session_id) %>%
  summarise(sess_turns = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(prolific_pid) %>%
  summarise(n_turns_prev = sum(sess_turns), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(PROLIFIC_PID = prolific_pid)


n_sessions_logged       <- nrow(engagement_sessions)
n_sessions_with_turns   <- sum(engagement_sessions$sess_turns > 0)
n_sessions_missing_open <- sum(engagement_sessions$sess_turns > 0 &
                                 !engagement_sessions$sess_opener)

data_treatments_eng <- data_treatments %>%
  left_join(engagement,      by = "PROLIFIC_PID") %>%
  left_join(engagement_prev, by = "PROLIFIC_PID")

turns_before_after <- data_treatments_eng %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_log_before  = sum(!is.na(n_turns_prev)),
    n_log_after   = sum(!is.na(n_turns)),
    mean_before   = round(mean(n_turns_prev, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_after    = round(mean(n_turns,      na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_before = median(n_turns_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_after  = median(n_turns,      na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Group = unname(condition_labels[as.character(Group)]))

cat(sprintf(
  paste0("Study 1 engagement correction (non-flyer sessions):\n",
         "  system-prompt rows removed from the turn counts: %d\n",
         "  sessions with at least one later turn: %d of %d logged sessions\n",
         "  ... of those, opening system-prompt row missing: %d\n",
         "  participants with any log rows (n_log): %d before, %d after\n",
         "  per-condition turns, before vs after:\n"),
  n_system_prompt_rows, n_sessions_with_turns, n_sessions_logged,
  n_sessions_missing_open,
  sum(turns_before_after$n_log_before), sum(turns_before_after$n_log_after)))

# Widened locally so the seven before/after columns print on one line.
local({
  old_width <- options(width = 200)
  on.exit(options(old_width))
  print(as.data.frame(turns_before_after), row.names = FALSE)
})


log_coverage <- data_treatments_eng %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    no_log       = sum(is.na(n_turns)),
    opener_only  = sum(!is.na(n_turns) & n_turns == 0),               # opener row survived, no later turn
    partial_log  = sum(!is.na(n_turns) & n_turns > 0 & !log_complete),
    complete_log = sum(!is.na(n_turns) & log_complete),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Group = unname(condition_labels[as.character(Group)]))
stopifnot(all(log_coverage$no_log + log_coverage$opener_only + log_coverage$partial_log + log_coverage$complete_log == log_coverage$n))

log_coverage %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Condition", "$n$", "No log rows", "Opener row only (0 turns)",
                      "Partial log ($\\geq$1 turn)", "Complete log"),
        caption = "Chatbot log coverage by condition. Rows were lost to Google Sheets write failures during high-concurrency recruitment, so engagement is only partially observed; the sensitivity refit in step 8 restricts to participants with complete logs.") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")


log_coverage %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Condition", "$n$", "No log rows", "Opener row only (0 turns)",
                      "Partial log ($\\geq$1 turn)", "Complete log"),
        label = "supp_s1_log_coverage",
        caption = "Study 1: chatbot log coverage by condition (\\textsc{Static Information} held out because those participants did not interact with a chatbot). Rows were lost to Google Sheets write failures during high-concurrency recruitment, so recorded engagement is a lower bound; the dose-response sensitivity refit is restricted to the complete-log column.",
        format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  kableExtra::save_kable(file = "tables/study1_engagement_log_coverage.tex")

engagement_desc <- data_treatments_eng %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    # The denominators behind the means: how many participants contributed any
    # log row at all, and how many contributed a verifiably complete log.
    n_log          = sum(!is.na(n_turns)),
    n_complete     = sum(!is.na(n_turns) & log_complete),
    n_turns_mean   = mean(n_turns,           na.rm = TRUE),

    duration_med   = median(chat_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Group = unname(condition_labels[as.character(Group)]))

engagement_desc %>%
  kable(digits = 2,
        caption = "Chatbot engagement by condition (Static Information held out; participants in that condition did not interact with a chatbot)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

# LaTeX version for export, saved to tables/.
engagement_desc %>%
  kable(digits = 2,
        col.names = c("Condition", "$n$", "$n$ with log", "$n$ complete log",
                      "Turns: mean", "Turns: SD", "Turns: median",
                      "Duration: mean", "Duration: SD", "Duration: median"),
        label = "supp_s1_engagement_desc",
        caption = "Study 1: recorded chatbot engagement by condition (\\textsc{Static Information} held out because those participants did not interact with a chatbot). Means and medians are computed over the participants with log rows, so they describe recorded engagement, a lower bound on actual engagement.",
        format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                            latex_options = "scale_down") %>%
  kableExtra::save_kable(file = "tables/study1_engagement_descriptives.tex")
```

```{r engagement-summary-stats}

ENG_DATA <- data_treatments_eng          

engagement_summary_stats <- function(df, study_num) {
  logged   <- dplyr::filter(df, !is.na(n_turns))
  with_dur <- dplyr::filter(logged, !is.na(chat_duration_min))
  stopifnot(nrow(logged) > 0, nrow(with_dur) > 0, nlevels(droplevels(factor(logged$Group))) > 1)

  # Classical one-way ANOVAs, as described in the supplement (anova(lm()) has
  # clean row names; summary(aov()) pads them with spaces).
  a_turns <- anova(lm(n_turns ~ Group, data = logged))
  a_dur   <- anova(lm(chat_duration_min ~ Group, data = with_dur))
  # Sensitivity: zero recorded turns means only the opener survived, so the
  # participant's own messages were lost; refit the turns ANOVA without them.
  a_turns_nz <- anova(lm(n_turns ~ Group, data = dplyr::filter(logged, n_turns > 0)))
  # Distribution-robust companions: recorded turns are zero-inflated (lost
  # writes) and durations are right-skewed with unequal variances (Table 20).
  w_turns  <- oneway.test(n_turns ~ Group, data = logged)
  w_dur    <- oneway.test(chat_duration_min ~ Group, data = with_dur)
  kw_turns <- kruskal.test(n_turns ~ Group, data = logged)
  kw_dur   <- kruskal.test(chat_duration_min ~ Group, data = with_dur)

  by_cond <- logged %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_turns = mean(n_turns),
                     mean_dur   = mean(chat_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  tibble::tibble(
    study = study_num,
    n_chatbot = nrow(df), n_logged = nrow(logged),
    n_zero_turns = sum(logged$n_turns == 0),
    n_nonzero = sum(logged$n_turns > 0),
    n_duration = nrow(with_dur), n_complete = sum(logged$log_complete),
    turns_F = a_turns["Group", "F value"], turns_df1 = a_turns["Group", "Df"],
    turns_df2 = a_turns["Residuals", "Df"], turns_p = a_turns["Group", "Pr(>F)"],
    turns_nz_F = a_turns_nz["Group", "F value"], turns_nz_df2 = a_turns_nz["Residuals", "Df"], turns_nz_p = a_turns_nz["Group", "Pr(>F)"],
    dur_F = a_dur["Group", "F value"], dur_df1 = a_dur["Group", "Df"],
    dur_df2 = a_dur["Residuals", "Df"], dur_p = a_dur["Group", "Pr(>F)"],
    turns_welch_F = unname(w_turns$statistic), turns_welch_df2 = unname(w_turns$parameter[2]),
    turns_welch_p = w_turns$p.value,
    dur_welch_F = unname(w_dur$statistic), dur_welch_df2 = unname(w_dur$parameter[2]),
    dur_welch_p = w_dur$p.value,
    turns_kw_chisq = unname(kw_turns$statistic), turns_kw_p = kw_turns$p.value,
    dur_kw_chisq = unname(kw_dur$statistic), dur_kw_p = kw_dur$p.value,
    r_pearson  = cor(with_dur$n_turns, with_dur$chat_duration_min),
    r_spearman = cor(with_dur$n_turns, with_dur$chat_duration_min, method = "spearman"),
    mean_turns_all_logged   = mean(logged$n_turns),
    median_turns_all_logged = median(logged$n_turns),
    mean_turns_complete     = mean(logged$n_turns[logged$log_complete]),
    mean_turns_partial      = mean(logged$n_turns[!logged$log_complete]),
    mean_turns_nonzero      = mean(logged$n_turns[logged$n_turns > 0]),
    most_turns_condition    = as.character(by_cond$Group[which.max(by_cond$mean_turns)]),
    fewest_turns_condition  = as.character(by_cond$Group[which.min(by_cond$mean_turns)]),
    longest_condition       = as.character(by_cond$Group[which.max(by_cond$mean_dur)])
  )
}
```

```{r exploratory-engagement-robustness-2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 4. MERGE ENGAGEMENT INTO LONG LMM DATA VIA anon_id
id_map <- data_treatments %>% select(anon_id, PROLIFIC_PID)

lmm_data_eng <- lmm_data %>%
  left_join(id_map,    by = "anon_id") %>%
  left_join(engagement, by = "PROLIFIC_PID")


eng_measures <- c(chat_duration_z = "chat_duration_min")

standardise_eng <- function(data, eng_var) {
  raw_var <- eng_measures[[eng_var]]
  d <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[raw_var]]))
  per_participant <- d %>% distinct(anon_id, raw = .data[[raw_var]])
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(per_participant$anon_id))     # one value per participant
  per_participant[[eng_var]] <- as.numeric(scale(per_participant$raw))
  d %>%
    select(-any_of(eng_var)) %>%
    left_join(per_participant %>% select(anon_id, all_of(eng_var)), by = "anon_id")
}

fit_eng_lmm <- function(dv_label, eng_var, data = lmm_data_eng) {
  d <- standardise_eng(filter(data, DV == dv_label), eng_var)
  f <- as.formula(
    sprintf("score ~ Group * time + %s + time:%s + (1 | anon_id)", eng_var, eng_var)
  )
  lmer(f, data = d)
}


fit_primary_lmm_sub <- function(dv_label, eng_var, data = lmm_data_eng) {
  d <- standardise_eng(filter(data, DV == dv_label), eng_var)
  lmer(score ~ Group * time + (1 | anon_id), data = d)
}

lmm_DV1_dur <- fit_eng_lmm("DV1", "chat_duration_z")
lmm_DV2_dur <- fit_eng_lmm("DV2", "chat_duration_z")
lmm_DV3_dur <- fit_eng_lmm("DV3", "chat_duration_z")

lmm_DV1_prim_dur <- fit_primary_lmm_sub("DV1", "chat_duration_z")
lmm_DV2_prim_dur <- fit_primary_lmm_sub("DV2", "chat_duration_z")
lmm_DV3_prim_dur <- fit_primary_lmm_sub("DV3", "chat_duration_z")

# Checks: engagement enters each model with exactly one value per participant,
# standardised (mean 0, SD 1) over that model's participants; and the
# coefficient names are the intended terms.
check_eng_model <- function(m, eng_var) {
  fr <- m@frame
  per_p <- fr %>% distinct(anon_id, .data[[eng_var]])
  stopifnot(nrow(per_p) == n_distinct(fr$anon_id),
            isTRUE(all.equal(mean(per_p[[eng_var]]), 0, tolerance = 1e-8)),
            isTRUE(all.equal(sd(per_p[[eng_var]]),   1, tolerance = 1e-8)),
            all(c(eng_var, paste0("timePost:", eng_var),
                  "Groupdebunking:timePost", "Groupself_reflection:timePost",
                  "Groupempathy:timePost", "Grouproleplay:timePost") %in% names(fixef(m))))
  invisible(nrow(per_p))
}
invisible(lapply(list(lmm_DV1_dur, lmm_DV2_dur, lmm_DV3_dur), check_eng_model, eng_var = "chat_duration_z"))

cat(sprintf("\nStudy %s: duration-adjusted LMM, DV2 (Refugee Support) -- formula and fixed effects\n", STUDY_NUM))
print(formula(lmm_DV2_dur))
print(round(summary(lmm_DV2_dur)$coefficients, 4))

eng_control_labels <- c(chat_duration_z = "Chat Duration (z)")


relabel_eng_term <- function(term, eng_var) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    term == paste0("timePost:", eng_var) ~ paste0("Post \u00D7 ", unname(eng_control_labels[eng_var])),
    term == eng_var                      ~ unname(eng_control_labels[eng_var]),
    TRUE                                 ~ relabel_term(term)
  )
}


eng_contrasts <- function(model, dv_name, eng_var = NULL) {
  tidy_df <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE)

  intervention_rows <- tidy_df %>%
    filter(grepl("^Group.*:timePost$", term)) %>%
    mutate(
      Row         = "Intervention vs Neutral (at avg engagement)",
      p_one_raw   = one_sided_p(p.value, estimate),
      p_holm_within_dv = p.adjust(p_one_raw, method = "holm")
    )

  eng_rows <- if (is.null(eng_var)) NULL else
    tidy_df %>%
      filter(term %in% c(paste0("timePost:", eng_var), eng_var)) %>%
      mutate(
        Row       = ifelse(term == eng_var,
                           "Engagement main effect (Pre level)",
                           "Dose-response: Post \u00D7 Engagement"),
        p_one_raw = ifelse(term == eng_var, p.value, one_sided_p(p.value, estimate)),
        p_holm_within_dv = NA_real_
      )

  bind_rows(intervention_rows, eng_rows) %>%
    transmute(
      DV          = dv_labels[[dv_name]],
      Eng_control = if (is.null(eng_var)) "None (primary model)" else unname(eng_control_labels[eng_var]),
      Row,
      Term        = if (is.null(eng_var)) relabel_term(term) else relabel_eng_term(term, eng_var),
      Estimate    = round(estimate, 3),
      SE          = round(std.error, 3),
      t           = round(statistic, 3),
      CI_low      = round(conf.low, 3),
      CI_high     = round(conf.high, 3),
      # one-sided for contrasts and dose-response; two-sided for the main effect
      p_one_sided = round(p_one_raw, 4),
      p_holm_within_dv = round(p_holm_within_dv, 4)
    )
}

  eng_contrasts(lmm_DV3_dur, "DV3", "chat_duration_z")
)

}
```

# Multiverse robustness (sidedness x Holm scope)

The primary in-text confirmatory result above uses one-sided p-values (H1: treatments improve outcomes, estimate > 0) with Holm correction within each DV (across 4 treatment-vs-Neutral interaction contrasts). The table below re-expresses the same 12 contrasts (4 treatments x 3 DVs) under a 2 (sidedness) x 3 (Holm scope) grid of analytical choices. No additional models are refit; only the p-value reweighting and adjustment varies. The row matching the primary specification (`one_sided` x `within_dv`) is marked PRIMARY.

```{r}

build_multiverse <- function(contrast_df_list) {
  all_contrasts <- dplyr::bind_rows(contrast_df_list, .id = "DV")

  one_spec <- function(side, scope) {
    df <- all_contrasts %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_raw = if (side == "two_sided") p_two
                else one_sided_p(p_two, estimate)
      )

    if (scope == "none") {
      df$p_adj <- df$p_raw
    } else if (scope == "within_dv") {
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(DV) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, "holm")) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup()
    } else {
      df$p_adj <- p.adjust(df$p_raw, "holm")
    }

    df %>% dplyr::mutate(
      sidedness  = side,
      holm_scope = scope,
      primary    = (side == "one_sided") & (scope == "within_dv")
    )
  }

  specs <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    sidedness  = c("two_sided", "one_sided"),
    holm_scope = c("none", "within_dv", "across_dv")
  )

  purrr::map2_dfr(specs$sidedness, specs$holm_scope, one_spec)
}

format_multiverse <- function(mv) {
  mv %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Contrast      = contrast,
      Estimate      = sprintf("%.3f", estimate),
      SE            = sprintf("%.3f", SE),
      p_raw         = sprintf("%.3f", p_raw),
      p_adj         = sprintf("%.3f", p_adj),
      stars = dplyr::case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_adj < 0.10  ~ "+",
        TRUE          ~ ""
      ),
      Spec   = ifelse(primary,
                      paste0("PRIMARY: ", sidedness, " x ", holm_scope),
                      paste0(sidedness, " x ", holm_scope))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(DV, Contrast, Estimate, SE, Spec, p_raw, p_adj, stars)
}


mv_input <- list(
  Perceptions = contr_DV1 %>% dplyr::transmute(
    contrast = term, estimate = Estimate, SE = SE, p_two = p_two_sided
  ),
  `Refugee Support` = contr_DV2 %>% dplyr::transmute(
    contrast = term, estimate = Estimate, SE = SE, p_two = p_two_sided
  ),
  `Policy Endorsement` = contr_DV3 %>% dplyr::transmute(
    contrast = term, estimate = Estimate, SE = SE, p_two = p_two_sided
  )
)

multiverse_tbl <- build_multiverse(mv_input)

format_multiverse(multiverse_tbl) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(DV, Contrast, Spec) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Multiverse robustness: 2 (sidedness) x 3 (Holm scope) x 12 contrasts (4 treatments x 3 DVs). PRIMARY = primary specification (one-sided x within-DV Holm)."
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
```
